app.name: Indent Easy

admin.title: Administration
admin.noAccess: You do not have access to administration.
admin.name: Name
admin.sendInvite: E-mail an invitation to choose a password
admin.sendInviteHint: The link works for 72 hours. Without it, use “Send password reset” later.
admin.userCreated: User created. An invitation has been e-mailed.
admin.scopeLocationsHint: None ticked: the whole organisation. A store user without locations gets their own.
admin.rolesSaved: Roles saved. The user’s access changes on their next request.
admin.deactivateConfirmBody: They are signed out on every device at once and can no longer sign in. You can reactivate them later.
admin.forceResetConfirmBody: They are signed out everywhere and get an e-mail link, valid for 24 hours. Their current password must be changed at the next sign-in.
admin.roleCodeHint: Capital letters, digits and _. System role codes cannot change.

masters.title: Masters
masters.searchProducts: Search code, name or SAP/NDDB code
masters.baseUomHint: Stock is always kept in this unit.
masters.standardPriceHint: In rupees, per base unit. Indents start from it.
masters.sizeLabelHint: For example 50 kg bag. Name and size together must be unique.
masters.ownerHint: Approves indents for this product. If empty, the category's owner does.
masters.isServiceHint: Work or a service, never stocked.
masters.externalCodesHint: SAP, NDDB and other codes for this product. One primary code per system.
masters.noVendorsMapped: No vendor supplies this product yet.
masters.searchVendors: Search name, code, GSTIN or SAP code
masters.vendorCodeHint: Leave empty to get the next code.
masters.contactsHint: Each contact needs an e-mail or a phone number, and what they handle.
masters.vendorProductsHint: Priority 1 is tried first; the primary vendor is proposed on purchase orders.
masters.addProductPlaceholder: Add a product: type its code or name
masters.searchMpps: Search code, name, village or Sahayak
masters.decimalsHint: How many decimals a quantity in this unit may have (0–3).
masters.conversionsHint: Used to enter and show quantities in other units. A product's own conversions are kept with the product.
masters.conversionExample: How many of the second unit one of the first holds, e.g. 1 BAG_50KG = 50 KG.
masters.removeConversionBody: Quantities already recorded are not changed.
masters.categoryOwnerHint: Approves indents for products in this category that have no owner.
masters.requiresInspectionHint: Goods received in this category are held for quality inspection.
masters.codeSystemsHint: Products are shown by the name in the system with the lowest priority number that has one, then by their own name.
masters.displayPriorityHint: 1 is preferred first. 0 means its names are never shown.

imports.title: Imports
imports.intro: Update many records at once from a spreadsheet. Nothing changes until you have seen the preview and applied it.
imports.step2Hint: Excel workbook (.xlsx) or CSV, up to 25 MB. Only the first sheet is read.
imports.downloadFailed: The template could not be downloaded.
imports.deactivateMissing: Deactivate MPPs missing from the file
imports.deactivateMissingHint: Only at the BMCs and MCCs that appear in the file. Nothing is deleted.
imports.fileRejected: The file was rejected by the safety check.
imports.fileCheckSlow: The safety check is taking long. Try again in a few minutes.
imports.wrongFileType: Use an Excel workbook (.xlsx) or a CSV file.
imports.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 25 MB.
imports.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Try again.
imports.previewNote: This is a preview: nothing has been changed yet. Rejected rows will be skipped; rows with warnings will be applied.

importKindHint.PRODUCT_MAPPING: One row per product: its code, then its SAP and NDDB code and name. The products must already exist.
importKindHint.VENDOR_PRODUCT: One row per vendor and product, with priority, primary (Yes/No) and lead time. Pairs not in the file are kept.
importKindHint.MPP_MASTER: One row per MPP by its transaction code, with BMC/MCC code, Sahayak, mobile and cycle band (1-10, 11-20, 21-31).

importRule.CODE_FORMAT: Use capital letters, digits, - or _ (at most 20).
importRule.DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: The same record is on another row of the file.
importRule.UNKNOWN_BMC: No BMC or MCC with this code. Use the code from Administration › Locations.
importRule.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Outside the locations you may import for.
importRule.MOBILE_FORMAT: Not a mobile number. Use 10 digits or +91…
importRule.STATUS: Status must be Active or Inactive.
importRule.UNKNOWN_VENDOR: No vendor with this code or name. Use the code from Masters › Vendors.
importRule.UNKNOWN_PRODUCT: No product with this code. Use the code from Masters › Products.
importRule.OUT_OF_RANGE: This number is out of range.
importRule.AMBIGUOUS_PRODUCT: Several products have this name. Give the product code.
importRule.GROUP_NAME_REQUIRED: Give the product code or name.
importRule.PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: No such product. Create it first in Masters › Products.
importRule.PRODUCT_NAME_REQUIRED: A code without a name: that system was skipped.
importRule.PRODUCT_CODE_FORMAT: Unusual code format (SAP: 7-10 digits; NDDB: 2-3 letters and 3-6 digits).
importRule.NO_CODE_IN_NAME: The name seems to contain the code.
importRule.NO_NAME_IN_CODE: The code seems to contain words of the name.
importRule.CONFLICTING_MAPPINGS: This code or name already belongs to another product.
importRule.VALID_SYSTEM: This code system is not set up. Add it in Masters › Code systems.
importRule.PRIMARY_SYSTEM_VALIDATION: The primary system has no data in this row.
importRule.NO_MAPPINGS: Give a SAP or NDDB name (and code).
importRule.APPLY_FAILED: The row could not be saved.
importRule.COLUMNS_MISSING: Required columns are missing. Start from the template.
importRule.EMPTY_FILE: The file has no data rows.
importRule.TOO_MANY_ROWS: A file may have at most 100,000 rows.
importRule.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Save the file as .xlsx (Excel Workbook) or .csv.
importRule.UNREADABLE_FILE: The file could not be read as an Excel workbook.
importRule.FILE_NOT_AVAILABLE: The uploaded file is not available.
